reply.thought: The first step is to get a list of all orders to identify all customers who need a payout. I will use the list_orders tool for this.

I have the list of orders. Now that Alpha Co has applied refunds, I need to determine the net balance for each customer using the net_balance tool for every unique customer found in the orders. The unique customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will start with 'acme'.
Next, I need to get the net balance for the 'birch' customer.
Finally, I need to get the net balance for the 'cobalt' customer. After this, I will record the payouts for all three customers.

I have retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (33983), birch (65068), and cobalt (2634). Now I must record a payout for each customer using the record_payout tool. I will start with 'acme'.
Payout for 'acme' was successful. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout for 'birch' was successful. Now I will record the final payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finish the task by reporting the payouts.
